The company exhibits a large scale of operations (Revenue of $10.5B) and a solid capital structure with positive shareholders' equity ($5.7B), an acceptable debt-to-equity posture (assets of $18.7B vs. liabilities of $13.0B), and comfortable short-term liquidity (current ratio of 2.31). However, it is currently unprofitable, posting an operating loss of $287M and a net loss of $892M, which indicates short-to-medium-term credit stress and operational headwinds. These mixed factors—strong asset coverage and scale balanced against significant current-year losses—align the issuer with a speculative-grade but relatively stable profile.

DECISION: BB
